A friendly update, this weekend
A focused stint is easier with a plan
Travelers should check pet paperwork and crate readiness before you head to the airport.

Animal Travel Notice

Please review your travel plans early so your pet can move through the journey with less stress. Our handlers use calm, humane methods around animals, and we give clear guidance before departure so there are fewer surprises at drop-off. <<FACT F072>>

If you are bringing a large dog, please speak with the desk about the applicable fee before you arrive. <<FACT F057>> Keep food, water, and comfort items packed in a simple way, and make sure the crate is secure and clean.

For help with cat carriers, reptile enclosures, or any other pet travel detail, the Companion Animal Travel Desk is ready to help you keep things smooth.
